highlights: Get up to 5 DBS Points (or 2 miles per dollar) for every S$1 spent on eligible online categories such as dining, groceries, and hotel bookings. For other purchases, you earn 1 DBS Point per S$5 (or 0.4 miles per dollar). Keep in mind that there’s a S$1,000 cap on rewards per calendar month.
pros: 5X DBS points (10 miles) for every S$5 spent on online purchases.
pros: 1X DBS points (2 miles) for every S$5 spent on other purchases.
pros: Complimentary e-commerce protection for online purchases.
pros: Enjoy special promotions and discounts for certain fashion, beauty and wellness stores.
pros: Both women and men can apply.
cons: 5X DBS points are only applicable for the first S$1,000 online spend per calendar month.
cons: DBS points are awarded for every S$5 spent.

extra.description: The DBS Woman's Card offers up to 5X DBS Points per S$5 spend (equivalent to 2mpd), along with the option for 0% instalment payments for 6-months, offering the ultimate guilt-free way to bring out your inner shopaholic.
